sloka: रथे स्थितो ऽहं शरचापपाणिर्न प्राकृतं कञ्चन योधयामि।यश्चास्ति कश्चिद्व्यवसाययुक्तो ददातु मे क्षिप्रमिहाद्य युद्धम् ।। ६.७१.४५ ।।
transliteration: rathe sthito 'haṁ śaracāpapāṇirna prākṛtaṁ kañcana yodhayāmi।yaścāsti kaścidvyavasāyayukto dadātu me kṣipramihādya yuddham ।। 6.71.45 ।।

translations.english: "I am with a bow and arrow seated in the chariot. Indeed, I am not strong in fighting with common warriors. Whoever is interested to fight now can come speedily to fight with me."
